slides.heading: Arithmetic Operators
slides.body: Arithmetic Operators is part of Mathematical and String Operations. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Arithmetic Operators
slides.body: Arithmetic operators let Python calculate numbers. You can add, subtract, multiply, and divide values inside your code.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: Arithmetic in Python is like using a calculator, except the instructions are saved and can be repeated anytime.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: Python follows operator rules exactly. Use variables and parentheses to make calculations readable and predictable.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Create a variable named total that adds 10 and 5, then print it.
